scripts.prep:copy-shared: powershell -Command "Remove-Item extension\shared_libs -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item shared_libs extension -Recurse"
scripts.test: node -e "const { readdirSync, statSync } = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); for (const f of readdirSync('tests')) { const p = `tests/${f}`; if (f.endsWith('.test.js') && statSync(p).isFile()) { console.log('>>', f); execSync(`node ${p}`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); } }"
scripts.build: npm run prep:copy-shared && cd extension && npm install
scripts.package: npm run build && cd extension && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-yarn --out ../dist/zeroui.vsix
